items.description: The bank's strategy aims to support infrastructure for connectivity and lower the cost of entry-level smartphone and broadband services

items.title: NCC Bank opens ‘China Desk’ to serve businesses
items.description: NCC Bank PLC has launched a specialised banking desk to provide integrated financial services to Chinese businesses and investors operating in Bangladesh.

items.title: Citizens Bank opens sub-branch in Keraniganj
items.description: Citizens Bank PLC has inaugurated a sub-branch in Ruhitpur, Keraniganj, Dhaka, to expand its banking services and support local businesses.

items.title: China’s Q3 growth narrowly beats forecasts
items.description: China’s economy grew slightly more than expected in the third quarter, but Monday’s figures still came in at the lower end of the government’s full-year target, as the global energy shock and weak domestic demand counter surging exports.

items.title: Confidence Power to raise Tk 400cr
items.description: Confidence Power and Energy PLC, a concern of Confidence Group, plans to raise Tk 400 crore through a public offering to fund two major grid-tied solar power projects and partially settle existing debts.

items.title: Three state bank MDs face early exit
items.description: The government has decided to cancel the remaining tenure of the contractual appointments of the managing directors and chief executive officers of three major state-owned commercial banks: Sonali, Janata and Rupali.

items.title: Midland Bank rolls out Visa Signature credit card
items.description: Midland Bank PLC has launched its Visa Signature credit card, offering customers an array of premium lifestyle, travel, dining and payment privileges.
